# D&Z Sculpture

> D&Z Sculpture is a custom metal and bronze sculpture manufacturer specializing in large-scale public art installations, outdoor sculptures, and bespoke statuary using traditional lost-wax casting and modern welding techniques.

D&Z Sculpture offers an extensive catalog of custom sculptures including bronze statues, stainless steel art, Corten steel garden pieces, and architectural installations. The company serves clients seeking high-quality public art, landscape design elements, and memorial sculptures with expertise in both traditional casting methods and contemporary metal fabrication.

## Key Topics

- Lost-wax casting
- Stainless steel sculpture
- Bronze sculpture
- Corten steel
- Custom sculptures
- Public art installation
- Metal sculpture
- Outdoor fountain
- Abstract sculpture
- Figure sculpture
- Welding
- Landscape design
- Large-scale statuary
- Garden sculpture
- Memorial art
